title: Replication code for "Industrialization, physical activity, and skeletal health: Evidence from a within-population study of the Indigenous peoples of Peninsular Malaysia"
description:
Replication code for the OA HeLP study of physical activity and bone health in the Orang Asli of Peninsular Malaysia (under review, Journal of Bone and Mineral Research). Bayesian regression (brms / Stan) estimating average exposure-response and marginal-effect functions for (1) physical activity to bone biomarkers and speed-of-sound under a mediator DAG, and (2) a community-level industrialization index to those outcomes via a one-stage hierarchical model with a community random intercept.

License note: the code is released under the MIT License. This archive contains code only; the analytical data are not distributed here and are available on request from the corresponding author under the OA HeLP data-governance terms.
